item.tib: yang snying bcud du dril ba gzungs mchog bsam 'phel nor bu
item.coloph: ces pa'i mdo chog dri med mar zhi'i gser lta bu/ gshen rab nyid las mi zhan pa'i tshangs pa gtsug phud kyi rol gar/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo ldan snying po'iu0f38snyan rgyud mdzad mdo nang nas/ yang snying bcud du phyung ba'i gzungs mchog bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bstan pa'i gsal byed dus kyi la tshig 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi rjes su 'dzin tshul pa/ phyi ltar so thar ming 'dzin g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa'am/ nang ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i ming tho tshe dbang bde chen snying po gsang ba byang sems ming mdog 'gro 'dul rnam rol gar gyi dbang phyug brda' spyod ming mthong kun mkhyen lung rig (?)rgya mtsho blo ldan/ sa gsum bstan pa'i shing rta chen po sha ri dbu chen mi yi gar rol mngon par bstan pa'i rig 'dzin yongs kyi khyu mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug smon lam g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi skyabs gur du tshud pa'i/ khol po ba des shar grol smin gling du bla grwa 'ga' yi thugs bzhed du bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang / bstan pa rin po che yi gsal byed du gyur nas/ 'dzam gling yongs la dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
